technical.zh-CN: ZGS 支持 IO-Link；200×120 规格在 -63kPa 下吸吊力 440N；CRP 空压机和 EXW 无线通信另成产品线，吸力参数不可跨规格套用。
technical.en: ZGS supports IO-Link; the 200×120 version reports 440N suction lifting force at -63kPa. CRP compressors and EXW wireless communication are separate lines; suction figures are configuration-specific.
